title: Effects of Italian Law 219/2017 in Pediatric Intensive Care Units
official: A National Survey on the Perceived Effects of Italian Law 219/2017 in Pediatric Intensive Care Units
summary: This study aims to investigate pediatric intensive care providers' knowledge, perceptions, and experiences with Law 219/2017 by means of a national multicentric non-interventional cross-sectional study.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Healthcare personnel employed in a pediatric intensive care units

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
